catalogue.note: Read from Figma at real size (375×800, nothing scaled): auto-layout frames are flex with Figma’s direction, gap, padding and alignment, everything else sits at its Figma offset, and all 39 boxes land on Figma’s to 0.05px. Square-cornered: the frame’s own 16px corners are left off and the diff leaves the four corners out (308 pixels). The account numbers are Satoshi Regular 11px with tabular lining figures (lnum, tnum) and 2% tracking, not a monospace face. Union Bank’s logo is a vector: Figma’s SVG export. Access Bank and GTCO are pictures: each is Figma’s own PNG export of the list at 4×, cut to the 40×40 instance, unchanged (the source PNGs carry gamma and colour chunks that Chrome applies and Figma does not, so the raw files come out a shade off: #E14200 for Figma’s #E04403). “Guaranty Trust Holding Company PLC” is cut short by Figma to “Guaranty Trust Holding Company…” (it drops the cut word whole, where CSS would keep “P…”): the page shows what Figma shows and keeps the full name in aria-label. The search box’s clear icon is in the file at opacity 0: it keeps its room and draws nothing. List items and the search box have a 1px inside stroke of black at 2%, drawn as an inset shadow. The search icon and back chevron are Figma’s SVG export. The iOS status bar is Figma’s SVG export: the time (SF Pro Text Semibold 17) as Figma’s outline, signal, wifi and battery as its vectors. No baseline needed moving here. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve edges: Figma’s rasteriser against Chrome’s. Flat fills match exactly.
